unit.why: A biographical sketch of R. Yitzhak Eizik: his trade, his learning, his discipleship of the Seer of Lublin and his traits. It ends with a short memorate by his grandson about a Seder night at his table, so it is a borderline story.
unit.boundary_note: part of a multi-division biography of R. Yitzhak Eizik; the next division turns to his wife Hinda

stories.start_quote: הרב הגדול רי"א הנ"ל לא התנהג כל ימיו
stories.summary_en: R. Yitzhak Eizik never served as a rabbi and lived by his own labour, wore white garments on Shabbat when he visited the Seer of Lublin, kept from gossip, held Torah talk at every meal and ate with his servants; his grandson recalls still tasting the holiness of his grandfather's Seder night.
